en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 1. Ahmad Ziyad ibn Ja`far al-Hamdani (ra) said: `Ali ibn Ibrahim said, on the authority of his father Ibrahim ibn Hashim, on the authority of `Ali ibn Ma`bad, on the authority of al-Husayn ibn Khalid that I asked al-Rida `Ali ibn Musa (AS): “O son of the Messenger of Allah! Tell me about the Qur’an. Is it a creator or created?”
Therefore, he (AS) replied, “It is neither a creator nor created; rather it is the Word of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.”
